title: Explaining a delay or a problem
intro: When something slips, say it early and honestly, explain the cause briefly, and give the new plan.
introNative: जब कोई काम delay हो जाए, तो जल्दी और ईमानदारी से बताइए, cause short में explain कीजिए, और नया plan दीजिए।

phrases.text: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.
phrases.native: अफ़सोस की बात है कि payment gateway integration में हमें एक issue आ गया है।
phrases.note: "Unfortunately" softens bad news; "run into" means you met it unexpectedly.

phrases.text: The root cause is a change in the third-party API that we weren't told about.
phrases.native: Root cause third-party API में हुआ एक change है, जिसके बारे में हमें बताया नहीं गया था।
phrases.note: Explain the cause in one sentence, without blaming a person.

phrases.text: The new timeline for the release is Wednesday the 20th.
phrases.native: Release की नई timeline बुधवार, 20 तारीख है।
phrases.note: Always give a specific new date, not "soon".

phrases.text: To avoid this in future, we'll add contract tests for every external API.
phrases.native: आगे ऐसा न हो, इसके लिए हम हर external API के लिए contract tests add करेंगे।
phrases.note: Clients want to know how you'll prevent it next time.

phrases.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience this causes your team.
phrases.native: इससे आपकी team को जो परेशानी हो रही है, उसके लिए मैं माफ़ी चाहता हूँ।
phrases.note: One short, sincere apology is enough; don't over-apologise.

steps.prompt: The release will be two days late. How do you raise it with the client?
steps.promptNative: Release दो दिन late होगा। आप client के सामने यह बात कैसे उठाएँगे?
options: Sorry sorry, there is a small delay, please adjust.
Release will not happen, some issue is there.
Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.
steps.answer: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.
steps.explanation: Name the problem calmly and specifically, then move to the plan.
steps.explanationNative: Problem को शांति से और specific तरीके से बताइए, फिर plan पर आइए।

steps.promptNative: Release की नई timeline बुधवार, 20 तारीख है।
steps.answer: The new timeline for the release is Wednesday the 20th.

steps.audioText: The root cause is a change in the third-party API that we weren't told about.
options: The root cause is a change in the third-party API that we weren't told about.
The root cause is a change in the third-party API that we weren't sure about.
The real cause was a change in the API that we told you about.
steps.answer: The root cause is a change in the third-party API that we weren't told about.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: We will deliver the fix by today itself.
options: We will deliver the fix by today itself.
We'll deliver the fix by the end of today.
We will deliver the fix today only itself.
We will be delivering fix by today evening itself.
steps.answer: We'll deliver the fix by the end of today.
steps.explanation: "Itself" isn't used to stress a time; say "by the end of today" or "later today".
steps.explanationNative: Time पर ज़ोर देने के लिए "itself" इस्तेमाल नहीं होता; "by the end of today" या "later today" कहें।

steps.prompt: The client asks: "How will you stop this happening again?" What's the best answer?
steps.promptNative: Client पूछते हैं: "आप इसे दोबारा होने से कैसे रोकेंगे?" सबसे अच्छा जवाब कौन-सा है?
options: We'll try our level best next time.
To avoid this in future, we'll add contract tests for every external API.
This will not happen again, I promise.
steps.answer: To avoid this in future, we'll add contract tests for every external API.
steps.explanation: A concrete action builds more trust than a promise.
steps.explanationNative: सिर्फ़ promise करने से ज़्यादा भरोसा एक concrete action बताने से बनता है।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: We are facing some issues, so kindly adjust with the delay.
options: We are facing some issues, so kindly adjust with the delay.
We've hit an issue, so we need to move the date by two days.
We are facing some issues, so please adjust the delay.
We are facing issues, kindly adjust for the delay.
steps.answer: We've hit an issue, so we need to move the date by two days.
steps.explanation: "Kindly adjust" asks the client to accept the problem; state the impact and the new date instead.
steps.explanationNative: "Kindly adjust" का मतलब है client से problem को accept करने के लिए कहना; इसकी जगह impact और नई date बताइए।

steps.promptNative: इससे आपकी team को जो परेशानी हो रही है, उसके लिए मैं माफ़ी चाहता हूँ।
steps.answer: I'm sorry for the inconvenience this causes your team.

steps.audioText: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.
options: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway configuration.
Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.
Fortunately, we've run the payment gateway integration.
steps.answer: Unfortunately, we've run into an issue with the payment gateway integration.

steps.prompt: Think of a real delay on your project. Out loud, explain it in 3–4 sentences: the issue, the cause, the new date, and how you'll avoid it next time.
steps.promptNative: अपने project के किसी असली delay के बारे में सोचिए। 3–4 sentences में बोलकर explain कीजिए: issue, cause, नई date, और अगली बार इससे कैसे बचेंगे।
